metadata.description: Formbay's partner AI integrations, delivered as Claude plugins.

plugins.name: fb-connector
plugins.description: Formbay connector — read solar-proposal data from partner web apps (e.g. Pylon / app.getpylon.com) and push projects into the Formbay job queue via the fb-job-push MCP server.

plugins.name: mcp-apps-demo
plugins.description: Formbay MCP Apps showcase (demo data): a Python MCP server whose tools open an interactive UI inside Claude (dashboard, chart, form, live updates) and show which MCP Apps UI features the host supports.
